law_record.title: Traffic controlled by official traffic-control devices (8)(e)
law_record.text: Where the signal is a steady red signal alone: Vehicular traffic facing the signal may not proceed on or through any private or public property to enter the intersecting street where traffic is not facing a red signal to avoid the red signal.

activation_conditions: a steady red signal faces the subject
the subject leaves the highway across property and re-enters on the intersecting street
residue: 'to avoid the red signal' is a purpose; the observable evidence the statute itself offers is the detour path around the signalized intersection
summary.subject: driver

timing_requirements.requirement: the manoeuvre is only visible over the whole detour: leaving the roadway, crossing the property and re-entering
the red indication must be facing the subject before the detour begins
